page.layout: One page of text: a running paragraph at the top, then one table below it in six columns (Indict., An. Iul., Lit.dom., Nabon., Feriae, Christi.), split into two blocks by a rule. Ian. notes sit between the Feriae and Christi columns.

main_text.p: æquinoctium autumnale,& subsequentem lunæ de-fectum. Qui vero prorsus ignorat continuationem annorum Nabonalari, statim à limine Albategnii fuerit arcendus.
main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabon. | Feriae | Christi.

page.notes: The table's first-block dashes and rules are printing ornaments and are not transcribed. The "Ian." notes are placed in the row where they stand beside the Feriae column. Printed numerals are copied as Arabic figures.
